en: Psalms 7

p.src: A meditation by David, which he sang to the LORD, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite.

en: A meditation by David, which he sang to the LORD, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite.
u.src: A meditation by David, which he sang to the LORD, concerning the words of Cush, the Benjamite.

p.src: 1  LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

en: LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,
u.src: 1  LORD, my God, I take refuge in you. Save me from all those who pursue me, and deliver me,

p.src: 2  lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.

en: lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.
u.src: 2  lest they tear apart my soul like a lion, ripping it in pieces, while there is no one to deliver.

p.src: 3  LORD, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

en: LORD, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,
u.src: 3  LORD, my God, if I have done this, if there is iniquity in my hands,

p.src: 4  if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),

en: if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),
u.src: 4  if I have rewarded evil to him who was at peace with me (yes, I have plundered him who without cause was my adversary),

p.src: 5  let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

en: let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.
u.src: 5  let the enemy pursue my soul, and overtake it; yes, let him tread my life down to the earth, and lay my glory in the dust. Selah.

p.src: 6  Arise, LORD, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

en: Arise, LORD, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.
u.src: 6  Arise, LORD, in your anger. Lift up yourself against the rage of my adversaries. Awake for me. You have commanded judgment.

p.src: 7  Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.

en: Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.
u.src: 7  Let the congregation of the peoples surround you. Rule over them on high.

p.src: 8  The LORD administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

en: The LORD administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.
u.src: 8  The LORD administers judgment to the peoples. Judge me, LORD, according to my righteousness, and to my integrity that is in me.

p.src: 9  Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

en: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.
u.src: 9  Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end, but establish the righteous; their minds and hearts are searched by the righteous God.

p.src: 10  My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

en: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
u.src: 10  My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.

p.src: 11  God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.

en: God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.
u.src: 11  God is a righteous judge, yes, a God who has indignation every day.

p.src: 12  If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

en: If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.
u.src: 12  If a man doesn’t repent, he will sharpen his sword; he has bent and strung his bow.

p.src: 13  He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

en: He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.
u.src: 13  He has also prepared for himself the instruments of death. He makes ready his flaming arrows.

p.src: 14  Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.

en: Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.
u.src: 14  Behold, he travails with iniquity. Yes, he has conceived mischief, and brought out falsehood.

en: 7:14 “Behold”, from “הִנֵּה”, means look at, take notice, observe, see, or gaze at. It is often used as an interjection.

p.src: 15  He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

en: He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.
u.src: 15  He has dug a hole, and has fallen into the pit which he made.

p.src: 16  The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

en: The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.
u.src: 16  The trouble he causes shall return to his own head. His violence shall come down on the crown of his own head.

p.src: 17  I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.

en: I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
u.src: 17  I will give thanks to the LORD according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
